name: file-sync-manager
description: 文件自动同步管理器 - 本地文件实时备份到百度网盘

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev:main" "npm run dev:renderer" "npm run dev:electron"
scripts.dev:electron: node -e "const{execSync}=require('child_process'),fs=require('fs'),http=require('http');function checkPreload(){try{fs.accessSync('dist/main/preload.js');return true}catch{return false}}function checkServer(){return new Promise(r=>{http.get('http://localhost:5173',()=>r(true)).on('error',()=>r(false))})}async function wait(){while(!checkPreload())await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500));console.log('[dev] preload 就绪，等待 Vite dev server...');let serverReady=false;while(!serverReady){serverReady=await checkServer();if(!serverReady)await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800))}console.log('[dev] Vite server 就绪，启动 Electron...');execSync('electron . --dev',{stdio:'inherit'})}wait()"
scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
